INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES (AMENDMENT) ACT
2010
AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR MINOR AMENDMENT TO THE
INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES ACT TO FACILITATE THE
REGISTRATION OF INTERNATIONAL COMPANIES
ENACTED BY THE PARLIAMENT OF TUVALU
9th September, 2010
Commencement [9th September, 2010]
1 Short Title
This Act may be cited as the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2010.
2 Commencement
This Act shall commence on the date of publication by exhibition.
3 Amendment to the International Companies Act
The International Companies Act is amended as follows —
(1) In section 63(1) of the Act, replace the number “61 with “62”.
(2) In section 66(1) of the Act, replace the number “64” with “65”.
(3) In section 66(3) of the Act, replace the number “64” with “65”.
(4) In section 11(1) of the Act —
(a) After the word “Limited” insert the words “Incorporated” or
“Corporation”,”.
(b) After the word “Ltd” insert the words “Inc” or “Corp”.
